# SDL3 (NuGet)

This repository is reponsible for building and publishing the native SDL3
binaries as NuGet packages.



## Current packages

### SDL3

<a title="A link to the OwlDomain.SDL3.Native NuGet package." href="https://www.nuget.org/packages/OwlDomain.SDL3.Native"><img alt="Status badge for the OwlDomain.SDL3.Native NuGet package." src="https://img.shields.io/nuget/v/OwlDomain.SDL3.Native?label=OwlDomain.SDL3.Native"></a>

Currently supported platforms:
- Linux *(x64 and Arm64)*.
- Windows *(x64 and Arm64)*.
- MacOS *(x64 and Arm64)*.
  - The binaries are included, however they remain untested, as such your
    mileage may vary depending on whether Apple is gonna be annoying.
